# Exact upstream source links

These links point to third-party servers. No source archives are included here.
The recorded versions and hashes identify the inputs; repository links provide
context and do not replace the exact archives. Availability was checked during
collection; continued access and the open reviews remain release responsibilities.

For libxcrypt, download both the original archive and Debian archive and use the
signed `.dsc` as the package manifest. The hashes below identify the checked bytes.
